REQ-001.design_rationale: Section 2.1 defines checking out origin/codex/ano-16455-oci-qa-fed-encryption (commit 69a69619) on pc-1 and running helm template across vedge-mv/vedge-api (oci-cloud-qa2-values.yaml), vedge-mv-unify-singleapp/placeholder (oci-cloud-qa-f1-values.yaml, oci-cloud-qa-f2-values.yaml), and external-secrets-seed (oci-cloud-qa-f1-extsec.yaml, oci-cloud-qa-f2-extsec.yaml).
REQ-001.tasks_rationale: Task 1 specifies checking out the MR branch on pc-1, running helm template for cloud-qa2, cloud-qa-f1, and cloud-qa-f2, and verifying rendered ExternalSecret/ao-encryption-keys and Deployment/vedge-api-secret-manager-service args, volumeMounts, and volumes.
REQ-001.debate_rationale: ADR-0048 evaluates the trade-off of lacking corporate 1Password Connect credentials on local K3s by combining offline helm template verification of ExternalSecret/ao-encryption-keys with declarative Secret/ao-encryption-keys rendering in charts/vedge-api-local.
REQ-001.evidence_rationale: verification.md Section 2.1 records verbatim helm template outputs for cloud-qa2, cloud-qa-f1, and cloud-qa-f2 on commit 69a6961 confirming ExternalSecret/ao-encryption-keys (secretStoreRef: onepassword-cluster-store, remoteRef: ao-encryption-keys/secrets.json) and Deployment/vedge-api-secret-manager file args and volume mounts.

REQ-002.design_rationale: Section 2.2 specifies building vedge-api-secret-manager-service and vedge-api-device-encryption-key-service JARs via Maven, building Docker images tagged ANO-17479, and importing into k3s ctr --namespace k8s.io across all 4 BEC K3s nodes.
REQ-002.tasks_rationale: Task 2 breaks down building both images from C:\Users\thang\gitlab\vedge_api on pc-1 and importing them into containerd on k3s-bec1-server, k3s-bec1-worker, k3s-bec2-server, and k3s-bec2-worker.
REQ-002.debate_rationale: ADR-0048 Decision 2 and Trade-offs & Risks verify pinned image tag alignment (ANO-17479) and memory headroom (-Xms64m -Xmx384m per service across 44 GB RAM per BEC cluster).
REQ-002.evidence_rationale: verification.md Section 2.2 records Maven BUILD SUCCESS, jar tf verification of FileSecretStore.class, and containerd image listings across k3s-bec1-server, k3s-bec1-worker, k3s-bec2-server, and k3s-bec2-worker.

REQ-003.design_rationale: Section 2.3 designs charts/vedge-api-local/ with templates/secret.yaml (Secret/ao-encryption-keys), per-service redisHosts, volumes, and volumeMounts in templates/deployment.yaml, and values-bec1.yaml/values-bec2.yaml enabling ports 17000 and 17100.
REQ-003.tasks_rationale: Task 3 specifies creating charts/vedge-api-local/, validating with helm lint, and deploying to pc1-bec1 (cloud-qa-f1) and pc1-bec2 (cloud-qa-f2) via helm upgrade.
REQ-003.debate_rationale: ADR-0048 Rejected Alternative 1 explicitly rejects imperative kubectl create secret or kubectl set volume mutations in favor of declarative Helm upgrades per RULE[no-kubectl-mutation] and RULE[adr-governance].
REQ-003.evidence_rationale: verification.md Section 2.3 confirms helm lint passed (0 chart(s) failed), helm upgrade succeeded on pc1-bec1 (revision 17) and pc1-bec2 (revision 14), and all 4 pods reached 1/1 Running with actuator health UP.

REQ-004.design_rationale: Section 1 and Section 2.4 detail end-to-end verification of FileSecretStore startup logs, Liquibase schema initialization in arm10 PostgreSQL (secret_manager_data), POST /secret-manager key activation on pc1-bec1, and Redis PubSub (SecretKeyChangeTask) synchronization to pc1-bec2.
REQ-004.tasks_rationale: Task 4 defines falsifiable checks for FileSecretStore startup logs, arm10 PostgreSQL table inspection, cross-BEC REST POST/GET verification, and recording verbatim output in verification.md.
REQ-004.debate_rationale: ADR-0048 Rejected Alternative 2 rejects pointing vedge-api-secret-manager-service to BEC-local Postgres/Redis, preserving the shared Federation Router Postgres/Redis topology on arm10 required for cross-BEC key synchronization.
